text:
Aisha Chen: Hey folks — first day! Quick setup Qs: can someone confirm Figma access flow for new product/design hires? Also where do I find the team roadmap/PRDs and the research onboarding checklist? Thanks!

Emily Rivera: welcome!! :tada: I just kicked off invites to the main Figma org for you. If you still see a "Request access" button, ping me and I’ll add you to the specific files. Also join #design-ops here and the Notion page 'Product Onboarding' — I dropped the link in #design-ops earlier.

Sam Patel: Hey Aisha — I’m your PM. Roadmap + PRDs live in Notion under /product/roadmap. I can add you to the space; send me your work email if it’s different from your SSO. If you need immediate read access: https://notion.redwood.com/product/roadmap (you’ll need company SSO).

Noah Kim: Research onboarding — welcome! We keep a condensed playbook at Notion > Research > Playbook. I’ll add you to the research project board and share the current participant list. We also have shadow slots for interviews if you want to sit in.

Lily (design-ops-bot): Aisha Chen has been added to the Figma team "Product — Designers" and to the "Redwood Design System" file.

Emily Rivera: Figma files to check: "Redwood Design System" and "Product — Q2 Features". For prototypes: toggle the device preview and enable dev-mode for handoff. If the file shows "Request access" I usually: 1) confirm you’re signed in with SSO account, 2) resend invite, 3) add manually.

Aisha Chen: Thanks! I still see "Request access" for "Product — Q2 Features" (I accepted the org invite).

Sam Patel: If the request hangs, try incognito to rule out personal account conflicts. Also confirm you're using SSO domain (login via redwood SSO). If that doesn’t work, Emily or I can add you directly by email.

Emily Rivera: Quick steps that usually fix it:
```
1) Sign out of Figma
2) Sign in via company SSO (redwood.com)
3) Open the invite link in a fresh window or incognito
4) If Request access persists, paste screenshot here and I will add you manually
```
Also design tokens are in the repo: https://github.com/redwood/design-tokens — come find me if you need token access for prototypes.

Noah Kim: Research tools FYI: we use Lookback for session recordings (invite sent separately) and transcripts go into Notion under the study page. When you upload, add the tag "eval" and tag me so I can link it to the metrics dashboard.

Aisha Chen: One last thing — where’s the dev handoff checklist? I want to make sure I follow proper export / spec steps.

Emily Rivera: Handoff checklist is in Notion (Design -> Handoff) + there's a Figma plugin note in the file. Short checklist: tokens confirmed, exportable assets named, dev-mode comments, link to spec PRD. I’ll DM you the template we use for feature handoffs.

Sam Patel: :thumbsup: looping @Noah to offer research shadow slots this week.

Noah Kim: I have availability Wed 10am and Thu 3pm for shadowing — which works for you?

Aisha Chen: Thu 3pm works great. Thanks again everyone — excited to get started!
